2609.11404.title: Deep-Fake CAPTCHA: Mitigating Next-Generation Social Engineering Attacks
2609.11404.paper_summary: This paper presents DF-CAPTCHA, an active defense against real-time deepfake impersonation in voice and video calls. Instead of passively searching for artifacts, DF-CAPTCHA prompts the caller to perform simple challenge-response tasks that are easy for humans but difficult for current real-time deepfake systems to generate convincingly. The framework verifies the response using four criteria: realism, identity consistency, task completion, and response time. We evaluate the approach across both audio and video modalities using user studies and experiments with real-time deepfake models. Results show that people often struggle to distinguish real-time deepfakes from authentic media, while DF-CAPTCHA substantially improves detection performance over passive methods, reaching high accuracy in both modalities. These findings suggest that active challenge-based verification is a practical and robust defense against next-generation social engineering attacks based on real-time deepfakes.
2609.11404.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了 DF-CAPTCHA，這是一種針對即時深度偽造聲音和視頻通話的主動防禦措施。<lb/>DF-CAPTCHA 不是被動地尋找工件，而是提示來電者執行簡單的挑戰-回應任務，這些任務對人類來說很簡單，但對當前的即時深度偽造系統來說卻難以令人信服地生成。<lb/>該框架使用四個標準來驗證回應：真實性、身份一致性、任務完成度和回應時間。<lb/>我們通過用戶研究和與即時深度偽造模型的實驗來評估該方法在音頻和視頻模態上的表現。<lb/>結果顯示，人們經常難以區分即時深度偽造和真實媒體，而 DF-CAPTCHA 在檢測性能上顯著優於被動方法，在兩種模態中均達到了高準確率。<lb/>這些發現表明，基於主動挑戰的驗證是一種針對基於即時深度偽造的下一代社會工程攻擊的實用且穩健的防禦措施。
